Package com.workshop.mcp.spec

Record Class AppTool

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.workshop.mcp.spec.AppTool
Record Components:
name - the unique identifier for the tool
description - a human-readable description of what the tool does
inputSchema - the schema defining the tool's input parameters
_meta - UI metadata that declares the resource URI for the interactive app
public record AppTool(String name, String description, InputSchema inputSchema, AppMeta _meta) extends Record
Represents a tool that declares MCP App UI capability via _meta.ui.resourceUri.

An AppTool is identical to a regular Tool in every way except that it carries an additional _meta field. When an MCP host receives an AppTool in the tools list, it treats the tool normally AND knows to preload the HTML resource at _meta.ui.resourceUri to render an interactive UI.

The full JSON representation sent to the host looks like:


 {
   "name": "key_word_search",
   "description": "Searches for a keyword across all project files.",
   "inputSchema": {
     "type": "object",
     "properties": {
       "keyword": { "type": "string", "description": "The keyword to search for" }
     },
     "required": ["keyword"]
   },
   "_meta": {
     "ui": {
       "resourceUri": "ui://keyword-search/mcp-app.html"
     },
     "ui/resourceUri": "ui://keyword-search/mcp-app.html"
   }
 }

There is no execution field. Revision 2026-07-28 removed Tool.execution — clients strip it silently — because its taskSupport hint forced a tools/list warmup before any task-augmented call. Whether a call becomes a task is now decided by the server per request.

Since:
1.0
